verdict.rationale: mParticle documents its own Data Subject Request API (v3 at opendsr.mparticle.com) and a GDPR/CCPA compliance guide, which points to product-level handling of subject requests such as erasure. However, the evidence never explicitly describes deletion operations or configurable retention periods, and the consent and forwarding rules are adjacent controls rather than retention or deletion. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of deletion/erasure request types, configurable data retention policies or TTLs, deletion scope across downstream outputs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
